question: If 50% of 70% of 2/6 of a number is 539. Find the number.
solution:
**Given:**

50% of 70% of (2 ÷ 6) of a number = 539

**Formula Used:**

x% = x ÷ 100

Fraction of a number = fraction × number

**Calculation:**

⇒ 50% = 50 ÷ 100 = 1 ÷ 2

⇒ 70% = 70 ÷ 100 = 7 ÷ 10

⇒ (1 ÷ 2) × (7 ÷ 10) × (2 ÷ 6) × Number = 539

⇒ (1 × 7 × 2) ÷ (2 × 10 × 6) × Number = 539

⇒ 14 ÷ 120 × Number = 539

⇒ 7 ÷ 60 × Number = 539

⇒ Number = 539 × 60 ÷ 7

⇒ Number = 539 × (60 ÷ 7)

⇒ Number = 77 × 60

⇒ Number = 4620

**∴ The correct answer is 4620.**
